GNU.excerpt: GNU is an operating system that is free software. GNU is a recursive acronym for GNU's Not Unix.

GCC.excerpt: GCC, the GNU Compiler Collection. The GNU Compiler Collection includes front ends for C, C++

GDB.excerpt: GDB: The GNU Project Debugger. Make your program stop on specified conditions. Examine what has happened, when your program has stopped.

NV12.excerpt: V4L2_PIX_FMT_NV12: 8 bits per component; 4:2:0; chroma order Cb, Cr; contiguous, linear. First plane luma; second interleaved chroma.

PR.excerpt: Pull requests are proposals to merge code changes into a project.

UDMABUF.excerpt: userspace dmabuf misc driver. A driver to let userspace turn memfd regions into dma-bufs.

VM.summary: A VM is a software-based computer running its own OS and apps. Virtualized resources come from a physical host, which can be a personal device; the definition is not limited to cloud servers.

WSL.excerpt: Windows Subsystem for Linux (WSL) is a feature of Windows that allows you to run a Linux environment on your Windows machine
